ZA.name: South Africa

dance_styles_details.name: Pantsula
dance_styles_details.description: Pantsula is a dance that originated during Apartheid in South Africa. In recent years, it’s had a vast resurgence in popularity.

dance_styles_details.name: Amapiano
dance_styles_details.description: It’s a sound that is distinctive, infectious, and uniquely South African, but also commanding global attention. Born out of the townships and influenced by hip hop, house, and jazz, ‘Amapiano’ is more than a genre of music - it’s a culture, a style, and a movement that is both innovative and disruptive in the way it’s transforming the industry.

AO.name: Angola
AO.highlight: Rich cultural heritage with traditional music and dance traditions

dance_styles_details.name: Kuduro
dance_styles_details.description: FPA Board Member Jeff Oppenheim was invited to Angola, Africa to explore the contemporary youth culture craze known as Kuduro (roughly translated as Hard Ass).  Jeff traveled from the concert halls and dance clubs in the capital city of Luanda to the to the house parties and streets of the surrounding Favelas.  He interviewed singers, DJs and promoters and discovered first-hand how the music and dance were uniquely Angolan.

dance_styles_details.name: Kizomba
dance_styles_details.description: Have you ever wondered: what is kizomba? Where does it come from? In today's video, we'll tell you exactly what kizomba is. From influences to impact, we'll share everything you need to know about Kizomba.

dance_styles_details.name: Afrohouse
dance_styles_details.description: Afrohouse is energetic, it is playful, and it is fun.  The Angolan version of the dance is a combination of Kuduro footwork and Afrohouse specific steps.   We get a taste of the flavor directly from Luanda, Angola.

dance_styles_details.name: Bikutsi
dance_styles_details.description: The Ewondo, or Yaunde, are centered on Yaoundé, Cameroon's capital, which was named for them. They also populate the eastern Mefou division and the Mfoundi and Nyong and So divisions in the Centre Province. The remainder of their territory lies in the northern portions of the Ocean division in the South Province.
